conditions.displayName: Any 5xx response from the approvefinalaccount service

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="approvefinalaccount" AND resource.labels.location="australia-southeast1" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx"

documentation.subject: approveFinalAccount returned a server error
documentation.content:
## What this means

The Callable Function `approveFinalAccount` (Cloud Run service `approvefinalaccount`, `australia-southeast1`) answered at least one request with an HTTP 5xx status. It is the only trusted financial operation: it recomputes and approves one Final Account revision in a single transaction.

Refused requests are NOT counted here. A missing sign-in or App Check token (401), a role or readiness refusal (403, 400) and a stale or busy draft (409) are 4xx responses and expected.

**Effect on data:** an approval is one transaction, so a failed call approved nothing or approved the whole revision. The user was told the outcome is uncertain and asked to reload.

## Read the log first

Logs Explorer:

`resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="approvefinalaccount" AND (severity>=ERROR OR httpRequest.status>=500)`

| What you find | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `final account call failed` with a stack | The handler threw an unexpected error. | Read the message and stack. Check whether the revision was approved (next section). Report it as a defect. |
| Status 503 and no error line, with `FINAL_ACCOUNT_APPROVAL_ENABLED` off | Approval is switched off on purpose; a user tried to approve. | Expected while the switch is off. No action beyond telling the user. |
| Status 504, or a request of about 120 seconds | The call hit the function's time limit. | Check the project's record volume and Firestore status. Do not raise the limit without approval. |
| Status 500 or 503 with a memory or instance message from Cloud Run | The container was terminated or could not start. | Check the revision is Ready: `gcloud run services describe approvefinalaccount --region australia-southeast1 --project constrapp-69b5d`. |

## Was anything approved?

Ask the user to reload Commercial, Final Account. The revision is either still a draft (nothing was written; they may try again) or approved (the call committed and only the reply was lost). An approval also writes one `final_account.approved` audit event. Never edit a Final Account revision in the console.

## Escalate

A repeated failure for the same project, or any sign of a partly written approval, goes to the Product Owner and the Lead Architect before anyone retries.

This notification is sent once per incident; the incident closes about an hour after the last failure. More failures may have followed the first.

Runbook: `ops/RUNBOOK.md`.
